page.overview:
What is Desert Moon Hideout?

The Desert Moon Hideout is a location in Final Fantasy Dimensions. It is located under Gardenia Slums and is a secret hideout of Desert Moon members. Azhar, a key member in the organization, can be found here. After the attack of imperial soldiers, nobody here can survive, including Azhar.

The Warriors of Darkness can access this place after they gain the trust from 5 people in the slums. Azhar then tells them the secret password, "Desert Rose", and sends them to meet Matoya.

A badly injured member of Desert Moon in the Forest Hut warns them that the hideout is being attacked before he dies. By the time Matoya and the Warriors of Darkness get there using the secret passage, most members are already dead. The bar owner turns out to be the traitor and is killed by them. They listen to Azhar's last words. Then the Warriors offer to help Matoya fight against the empire.
